'''Ammuud Height''' was a [[Mountain/Legends|mountain]] located on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ammuud/Legends|Ammuud]]. The mountain was situated relatively close to the [[Glayyd Stronghold]], and was taller than the peak that the [[Fortress/Legends|fortress]] was built into.<ref name="EGTPM" />
